title: A great chef's knife for the money!
text: A great chef's knife for the money!. I love to cook and I own a large variety of knives in my kitchen. I wasn't sure what to expect for this price, but I honestly was pleasantly surprised. First, it comes in a nice box, great for gift giving (bridal shower, housewarming, Christmas). Second it's attractive and unique with it's design. And lastly, it fits well in my hand (ergonomic) and slicing vegetables and meats is a breeze. This knife is sharp and durable and makes a great addition to any kitchen. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: KONOLL Chef Knife Forged Handmade 8 Inch Professional Kitchen Knife, Meat Cleaver HC Stainless German Steel with Full Tang Wood Handle
features: Germany High Quality Steel ➦ KONOLL series uses Germany steel - 5CR15MOV. A great steel for the everyday use of any chef. With an HRC of 56+/-2 it will take an angled edge and hold it for long enough to help extend the life of your knife (w/ general maintenance). The clad dimple allow for easy food release while slicing or dicing. This blade is great for vegetables, fruits, fish, and meats. [Please refrain from cutting frozen products as this may detriment the knife's edge.]

Weight/Balance ➦ The balance point runs heel to spine up the billet. Allowing the user a comfortable grip with precise cuts, and less wear and tear on the users hands. The weight is towards the blade of the knife making for efficient use during rock chopping motion.
